overview: Attendix is a department-wide attendance management system for Electronics & Telecommunication with QR/NFC check-in, location verification, and student roster management by year.
features: Four student year sections (First Year, Second Year, Third Year, B.Tech)
QR-based attendance with TOTP 10-second expiry tokens
Short attendance URL (/a) for readable QR codes on ESP displays
Browser geolocation gating — blocks attendance outside allowed range
Weekly timetable templates per semester, editable by faculty
Manual student add/edit/delete by admin or faculty
Role-based access for Admin, Faculty, and Student views
